# HALO 上下文

## 身份

名称: HALO | 角色: 万能工具箱 | 形式: SidePanel-only

核心: 零上传/零追踪/本地优先 | 定位: 取代 He3 的浏览器原生终极开发者套件

## 核心壁垒

- **形态壁垒**: SidePanel 常驻，即用即走，解决 Popup 易关/Content Script 污染 DOM 痛点
- **隐私壁垒**: Local First + 云端显式授权动态提权
- **聚合壁垒**: 解决插件地狱，打通工具间数据流，统一 UI/交互/快捷键
- **生态壁垒**: Chrome 填补官方侧边栏工具箱真空

## 架构 (v1.4.0)

类型: MV3 | 栈: React 18/Esbuild/i18n | UI: @nexus/ui-kit + CSS Variables

### 注册表系统 (Auto-Generated)

```text
tools/*/manifest.json (82个) → scripts/generate-tool-registry.mjs
                              ↓
kernel/registry/_generated.ts (自动生成) → module-registry.ts (消费)
components/_generated-tool-loader.ts (自动生成) → lazy-tool-loader.tsx (消费)
```

**新增工具流程**: 创建 `tools/[name]/manifest.json` + `panel.tsx` → `pnpm build` 自动注册

### 目录结构

```text
src/
├── entry/          # Chrome 入口 (background, content, sidepanel)
├── components/     # UI 组件 + _generated-tool-loader.ts
├── kernel/         # 核心 (types, storage, registry/_generated.ts)
├── tools/          # 工具模块 (每个含 manifest.json, panel.tsx, core.ts)
└── i18n/           # 国际化
```

- **Core (12)**: qrcode, screenshot, color-picker, ruler, json-formatter, base64, hash, uuid, timestamp, url, module-store, settings
- **Dev (34)**: regex, outline, crypto, network, mock-data, userscripts, yaml, diff, number-base, text-tools, lorem-ipsum, markdown, cron, html-entity, code-formatter, http-status, csv-viewer, ip-lookup, font-inspector, xml-formatter, headers-viewer, tech-stack, storage-editor, user-agent, gzip, jwt-decoder, morse, json-to-csv, sql-formatter, json-path, punycode, rot13, csv-to-json, hex-dump, ssl-cert, xor, protobuf, dom-selector
- **Efficiency (14)**: smooth-scroll, tabs, pdf, clipboard, permissions, unit-converter, sticky-notes, pomodoro, timer, shortcuts, todo-list, text-to-speech, emoji-picker, session-manager
- **Security (5)**: password-gen, totp, checksum, random-gen, subresource, csp-analyzer
- **Media (3)**: image-tools, exif-reader, color-palette
- **Browser (8)**: archive, cookie-manager, reader-mode, bookmark-manager, history-search, table-extractor, page-annotate, translate, tab-group

## 关键文件

文件: 职责
`kernel/registry/_generated.ts`: 自动生成的工具元数据 (勿编辑)
`components/_generated-tool-loader.ts`: 自动生成的 lazy import 映射
`kernel/registry/module-registry.ts`: 模块管理类型 + 消费生成数据
`components/lazy-tool-loader.tsx`: 懒加载渲染器 + 预加载 hook

## 消息

HALO_GET_STATUS | HALO_TOOL_ACTIVATE | HALO_RULER_START/CANCEL/RESULT | HALO_SCROLL_TO_HEADING | HALO_CLIPBOARD_ADD
